result.title: Latent Imagination for Parameterized Action Spaces
result.summary: Parameterized-action MDPs (PAMDPs) ask an agent to choose a discrete action together with continuous parameters whose meaning depends on that choice. Model-free PAMDP methods act fast but need many interactions; model-based methods are sample-efficient but plan at every decision, which makes them slow to act. We introduce HyLI (Hybrid Latent Imagination), a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely in the latent imagination of a world model and acts with a single forward pass. To address learning problems that the PAMDP structure creates, HyLI adds counterfactual mode evaluation, which gives every discrete action a learning signal at every imagined state, and success-window replay, which keeps rare successes in training. On seven standard PAMDP benchmarks, HyLI is within one published standard deviation of, or above, the published score of the strongest model-free baseline in our comparison on all 7 tasks, reaches 90% of that score with 2.4x fewer environment steps than that baseline (5.0x when its reward-free pre-training is counted), and decides 67x faster than the model-based planner DLPA at its published planner settings. It is the only method in our comparison that is both more sample-efficient than that baseline and fast enough for real-time control.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HyLI，在 world model 的 latent imagination 中训练同时选择离散动作与连续参数的混合策略，并加入反事实模式评估与成功窗口回放，使智能体单次前向即可决策而无需每步规划。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属 RL 世界模型的潜空间 rollout，与视觉推理主线无直接关联；但其在 latent 空间中展开想象轨迹、为每个离散选项提供反事实学习信号、并保留稀有成功样本的做法，可能为 latent 推理的轨迹监督与贡献分配提供可核查的概念线索。
